saw_lines: Bedding is bought on feel and trust, so shoppers decide in seconds whether the fabric is worth a click.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line of the ad, before a shopper reads any price.
Your same copy runs in 3 of 9 ads, so keep the body, rewrite the opening line and swap the creative in each of those three.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 30 Oct 2026
points: One exact copy runs in 3 of 9 ads, so the same pitch reaches the same shoppers. Keep the body text, rewrite the opening line in each, and give those three ads new creative showing the fabric on a made bed.
0 of 9 ads carry a proof number, so a new buyer has nothing concrete to trust. Pick one real figure you can stand behind, like a review count or orders shipped, and lead three ads with it.

3 of 9 copy ads open on “voilage aérien, rideau tamisant ou...”, and the rest share no story. Test two new angles against that opener, one on washing and softness, one on how a curtain changes a room.
19 of 28 ads are catalog feed ads with no story, so a scroller sees a product tile and no reason to stop. Add three story ads first: one bed being made, one curtain lit at dusk.

ads_1: Video stories of made beds and lit curtains, each with its own opener
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook and Instagram
